Release 2026-10-26 09:32

## Changes

### Features

- angular-query-experimental/injectDevtoolsPanel: add the 'theme' and 'hideDisabledQueries' options (#12316) (8f9dfcb30) by @sukvvon

### Fix

- angular-query-experimental/withDevtools: forward an unset 'theme' to the devtools so removing it falls back to the theme selected in the devtools Settings menu (#12315) (9e4253766) by @sukvvon
- solid-query-devtools: stop defaulting the 'theme' prop to 'system' so the theme chosen in the devtools settings applies when the prop is omitted (#12310) (f232b75e3) by @sukvvon
- vue-query-devtools: stop defaulting the 'theme' prop to 'system' so the theme chosen in the devtools settings applies when the prop is omitted (#12312) (a282bf807) by @sukvvon
- svelte-query-devtools: stop defaulting the 'theme' prop to 'system' so the theme chosen in the devtools settings applies when the prop is omitted (#12313) (aff30e36b) by @sukvvon
- vue-query/queryClient: infer the data and error types of 'getQueryState' from a tagged query key (#11921) (c5de051d6) by @sukvvon
- examples/lit/pagination: show the error message instead of the stringified error (#12187) (81e6a935a) by @sukvvon
- examples/lit/basic: show the error message instead of the stringified error (#12186) (1ed8158eb) by @sukvvon
- examples/angular/optimistic-updates: throw an 'HttpErrorResponse' from the mock so the failing mutation rolls back in 'onError' (#12173) (35d21b2d1) by @sukvvon
- examples/angular/infinite-query-with-max-pages: disable the previous page button while fetching the previous page instead of the next page (#12167) (c87c0eafb) by @sukvvon
- examples/vue/basic: share the post queries with 'queryOptions' in 'src/api.ts' and mark visited posts from the query cache (#12161) (71fb7632d) by @sukvvon
- examples/vue/dependent-queries: share the post and author queries with 'queryOptions' in 'src/api.ts' and mark visited posts from the query cache (#12162) (ca7af3373) by @sukvvon
- examples/vue/2.7-basic: share the post queries with 'queryOptions' in 'src/api.ts' and mark visited posts from the query cache (#12165) (c83595d0b) by @sukvvon
- examples/vue/2.6-basic: share the post queries with 'queryOptions' in 'src/api.ts' and mark visited posts from the query cache (#12164) (09cc250b5) by @sukvvon
- examples/vue/persister: share the post queries and persisters with 'queryOptions' in 'src/api.ts' and mark visited posts from the query cache (#12163) (582419393) by @sukvvon
- examples/vue: show 'Background Updating...' in the posts list and remove the unused 'refetch' (#12139) (5d67aa2ef) by @sukvvon
- examples/vue/persister: rename the heading from 'Vue Query - Basic' to 'Vue Query - Persister' (#12138) (c00eaa37b) by @sukvvon
- examples/vue/simple: remove the stray quote before the error message (#12134) (a4414a7f5) by @sukvvon
- examples/vue: throw on non-ok 'fetch' responses in the query functions (#12133) (b904739b0) by @sukvvon
